_comment: The list of valid emotional states, and the placeholder color for each (used only when no real avatar file exists at nori/static/avatars/<name>.<ext> -- see that folder's README). Adding a state means adding an entry here (name + color, both required; 'look' is optional and is only what the avatar builder asks the image model to draw -- see avatar_builder.py) plus an avatar file; no code change either way, BUT a brand-new state name needs a server restart to take effect (this file is only read once, at startup -- STATES/the tool's enum are fixed after that). Dropping in an avatar file for a state ALREADY in this list needs no restart. 'neutral' must stay in this list -- it's the decay target and the default for a user with no state set yet.

states.name: panic
states.look: wide, alarmed eyes, eyebrows pulled up and together, mouth open in a gasp, a look of real panic

states.name: neutral
states.look: relaxed and calm, mouth closed with the faintest hint of a smile, looking straight at the camera

states.name: happy
states.look: a warm, genuine smile showing a little teeth, eyes crinkled with real happiness

states.name: amused
states.look: a lopsided half-smile, bright eyes, as if trying not to laugh

states.name: sarcastic
states.look: one eyebrow raised, a smirk pulled to one side, eyes glancing sideways with dry irony

states.name: curious
states.look: head tilted slightly, eyebrows raised, wide attentive eyes, lips just parted

states.name: thinking
states.look: eyes looking up and to one side, lips pursed, a finger resting against the chin

states.name: concerned
states.look: brows drawn together and tilted up in the middle, a slight frown, soft worried eyes

states.name: surprised
states.look: eyebrows high, eyes wide open, mouth open in a round O

states.name: confused
states.look: brows uneven, nose slightly scrunched, head tilted, lips pressed to one side

states.name: skeptical
states.look: one eyebrow sharply raised, the other eye slightly narrowed, mouth flat and pulled to one side

states.name: annoyed
states.look: a flat stare, brows lowered, lips pressed together, visibly exasperated

states.name: determined
states.look: jaw set, brows lowered, a steady focused gaze, lips pressed in firm resolve

states.name: serious
states.look: no smile at all, a level steady gaze, brows straight and composed

states.name: relieved
states.look: shoulders dropped, eyes soft or closed, a slow exhale, a small grateful smile

states.name: proud
states.look: chin lifted slightly, a warm confident smile, bright eyes

states.name: embarrassed
states.look: flushed cheeks, a sheepish smile, eyes averted, a hand touching the back of the neck

states.name: sleepy
states.look: heavy half-closed eyelids, a slack mouth or a yawn, head drooping slightly

states.name: excited
states.look: wide bright eyes, a big open smile, eyebrows high, full of energy

states.name: deadpan
states.look: a completely flat expression, an unblinking stare straight at the camera, no emotion at all

states.name: angry
states.look: furrowed brows, a glaring stare, tight jaw, lips pressed hard together

states.name: flirty
states.look: a playful half-smile, one eyebrow slightly raised, chin tilted down, a sideways glance

states.name: drinking
states.look: holding a mug up and taking a sip, eyes closed or looking over the rim

states.name: thirsty
states.look: lips slightly parted and dry, eyes fixed longingly on a tall cold glass of water in front of them
